context_notes: Two independent premises this session held were falsified by measurement, and both are recorded rather than quietly dropped. (1) The rescope does NOT make scroll_cost per-page: show_ui_matrix?/1 gates the primitives matrix, so a page.* preview renders chrome plus one paragraph and never the page under test. Distinct values went 7 -> 4, and after quantization all 120 page floors read exactly 0.5. The planned 'floors are not all identical' assertion was dropped rather than written to fail. (2) The footgun cell is a status:'reserved' placeholder whose PNG never contained a left-push layout, so the planned centering assertion would have invented coverage; the real invariant lives in operator-phase-178-uat.spec.ts and is now source-scan-pinned. The governing insight for scroll_cost: the old document-wide read only LOOKED environment-stable because it measured a fixed sidebar catalog rather than the page. Making it correct is what made it sensitive to genuine cross-environment rendering differences.
